title: iris × germanica subsp. albicans
intro: Iris × germanica subsp. albicans, commonly known as the white German iris, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the iris family (Iridaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Iris × germanica subsp. albicans include wound healing, soothing skin irritations, and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, iridoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
